title: Late leaderboard Error response bypasses the new vacancy guard and poisons the current board
detail: The handler guards Ok responses with `Some(current) if current == vacancy_id` but the Error arm matches any vacancy id. A late error from a navigated-away vacancy sets the current vacancy's board to Failure, contradicting the guard comment above it.
recommended_fix: Guard the Error arm the same way (`Error(err), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id`) and let stale errors fall through to the no-op arm.

title: Stepper rail classes diverge: view_pipeline gains md:justify-end, view_rejected and view_auto_closed do not
evidence:
+        "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible md:justify-end",
...
+            "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible",
detail: All three containers previously shared one identical class string; the change adds md:justify-end only to the pipeline variant, so rejected/auto-closed steppers align differently on desktop for no stated reason.
recommended_fix: Either apply md:justify-end to all three rail containers or drop it from view_pipeline so the variants stay visually consistent.

title: ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage non-Success Ok arm never clears leaderboard_loading_more
evidence:
+        Ok(response), _, Some(current) if current == vacancy_id -> #(
+          Model(
+            ..model,
+            leaderboard: Success(response.entries),
+            leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(vacancy_id),
detail: This rewritten arm sets a fresh Success board but, unlike the Error arm, does not set leaderboard_loading_more: False; if a page response lands while the board was reset (e.g. filter change), the load-more spinner stays stuck.
recommended_fix: Add leaderboard_loading_more: False to this arm (and verify the Success(existing) arm also clears it).

title: Demo test comment misdescribes the old demo notification arm
evidence:
+  // decision as the real arm, so a vacancy-typed demo notification navigates
+  // too (previously the demo arm only handled application and no-opped
+  // vacancy).
detail: The old demo arm was `UserClickedNotification(id, _entity_type, _entity_id)` with no navigate effect at all — it no-opped BOTH entity types, not just vacancy. The comment contradicts the removed code shown in the same diff.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to state the demo arm previously navigated for neither entity type.

title: Dead binding `let _ = notifications` in demo deep-link test
evidence:
+  let #(notifications, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store)
+  unread |> should.equal(1)
+  after.show_notification_dropdown |> should.be_false
+  let _ = notifications
detail: `notifications` is bound only to be discarded; the test claims to pin 'marks the row read' but never inspects the notification list, so the mark-read contract is not actually verified.
recommended_fix: Assert the n-1 notification's is_read flag from `notifications` (fulfilling the comment's claim) instead of discarding the binding.

title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard success arm re-sets leaderboard_vacancy_id already set at fetch time
detail: Every dispatch site in the diff sets leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(id) alongside leaderboard: Loading, and the guard only passes when the tag already equals vacancy_id — so this assignment is provably a no-op in this arm.
recommended_fix: Drop the redundant field from the guarded success arm, or drop it from the dispatch sites and set it only on success — not both.
